module Book::Announceable
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  SITTING_STATE_KEY = :book_announceable_sitting

  class Sitting
    attr_reader :initial_published, :books
    attr_accessor :callbacks_registered

    def initialize
      @initial_published = {}
      @books = {}
      @callbacks_registered = false
    end
  end

  included do
    before_update :record_initial_publication_state
    before_destroy :record_initial_publication_state
    after_create :record_created_publication_state
    after_save :track_book_for_announcement
  end

  private
    def record_initial_publication_state
      record_id = id_in_database
      sitting = current_sitting
      unless sitting.initial_published.key?(record_id)
        sitting.initial_published[record_id] = self.class.unscoped.published.exists?(record_id)
      end
      ensure_sitting_callbacks(sitting)
    end

    def record_created_publication_state
      sitting = current_sitting
      unless sitting.initial_published.key?(id)
        sitting.initial_published[id] = false
      end
      ensure_sitting_callbacks(sitting)
    end

    def track_book_for_announcement
      sitting = current_sitting
      sitting.books[id] = self
      ensure_sitting_callbacks(sitting)
    end

    def current_sitting
      ActiveSupport::IsolatedExecutionState[SITTING_STATE_KEY] ||= Sitting.new
    end

    def ensure_sitting_callbacks(sitting)
      return if sitting.callbacks_registered

      sitting.callbacks_registered = true
      transaction = self.class.current_transaction
      transaction.after_commit { finalize_sitting(sitting, committed: true) }
      transaction.after_rollback { finalize_sitting(sitting, committed: false) }
    end

    def finalize_sitting(sitting, committed:)
      if self.class.current_transaction.open?
        sitting.callbacks_registered = false
        ensure_sitting_callbacks(sitting)
        return
      end

      if ActiveSupport::IsolatedExecutionState[SITTING_STATE_KEY].equal?(sitting)
        ActiveSupport::IsolatedExecutionState.delete(SITTING_STATE_KEY)
      end

      return unless committed

      sitting.books.each do |book_id, book|
        if !sitting.initial_published[book_id] && book.class.unscoped.published.exists?(book_id)

I have resolved the publication announcement issue:

- **Root causes**:
  1. `Book::Announceable` previously used `after_update_commit :announce_publication, if: :saved_change_to_published?`. When a sitting (transaction) marked a book live and performed subsequent work such as adding/updating pages (`Leaf` touches and locks/reloads its `Book`), `saved_change_to_published?` was cleared before commit, suppressing the announcement. Likewise, creating a book and taking it live in the same transaction bypassed `after_update_commit`.
  2. `if: :saved_change_to_published?` fired whenever `published` changed in either direction, causing unpublishing (`true` → `false`) to enqueue an announcement.

- **Fix**:
  - Updated `Book::Announceable` (`app/models/book/announceable.rb`) to record each book's pre-sitting publication state before modification and finalize on the outermost transaction's commit/rollback (`current_transaction.after_commit` / `after_rollback`), announcing each book once if and only if it was not live before the sitting and is live in the committed database state at the end of the sitting.
  - Added model and controller tests in `test/models/book/announceable_test.rb` and `test/controllers/books/publications_controller_test.rb` covering all sitting scenarios and rollback/savepoint edge cases.

I will now submit the final output.
